# Navimower Map Card 0.3.6-beta20

## Safer gate-area point insertion

This beta refines the visual gate-area editor introduced in beta19 so adding extra points no longer depends on the last-added vertex.

- The **first three points** of a new gate area are still placed freely by tapping the map.
- Once the polygon has three points, a normal map tap inserts a new vertex only when the tap is within **28 px** of an existing polygon edge.
- The nearest edge is selected in screen space, and the new point is inserted between that edge's two endpoints. This prevents new points from being appended to the end of the vertex list and creating accidental diagonal cuts through the area.
- The existing midpoint **+** handles remain available and still insert a point directly into that edge.
- The same near-edge insertion behavior is available while editing an existing gate area.
- Taps farther than 28 px from every edge are ignored and the editor shows a short hint instead of changing the polygon.
- Self-intersecting polygons are now highlighted with the Home Assistant error color, **Save** is disabled, and the editor explains that crossing edges must be fixed first.
- Backend validation in Navimower remains authoritative; this frontend check gives immediate feedback before a service call is made.

The map still intentionally disables normal pan/zoom while the gate-area editor is active. Position and zoom the map first, then press the pencil button for precise editing.

### Compatibility

Gate-area editing requires **Navimower 0.4.4-beta34 or newer**. Existing rendering and legacy rectangle support are unchanged.
